environment.description: Terraform provider OAuth server deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) with direct internet exposure via public IP. No load balancer, no WAF, no reverse proxy. The /authorize endpoint is directly accessible. The client_secret is stored in environment variable and rotated by the application itself every 60 seconds. Network security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080. No additional URL validation beyond the application code.

config.tls: none (plain HTTP despite code checking https scheme in redirect_uri)
